description:
What is This?
This is the Suzuki OEM Plastic Grille Nut.
These parts snap into the 4 square holes located in the Hood Member Uprights. These are situated directly behind the Grille so that the Grille can be attached to the Hood Member Supports with screws.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Plastic Grill Nuts
What Vehicle Does This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1992 – 1995
